title: Big Ideas in Tech for 2024
edition_framing: Each idea is what a16z partners expect builders to tackle in 2024.
notes: No visible date on the page. Page metadata datePublished 2023-11-29; first Wayback capture 2023-12-06.

entries.label: 21st Century Public Safety
entries.quote: It’s time for a national upgrade to our public safety systems.
entries.subject: Public safety technology
entries.author: David Ulevitch

entries.label: Smart Grids Will Power an Increasingly Electrified World
entries.quote: To implement this on a large scale, however, the grid must also transition from a unidirectional power flow model — from large power plants to consumers — to a “smart grid” that supports bi-directional flows from diverse sources and locations.
entries.subject: Smart grids and distributed energy
entries.author: Ryan McEntush

entries.label: Cost-Effective Swarming for Defense
entries.quote: A network of autonomous systems collaborating, communicating, and coordinating would unlock a new paradigm in defense.
entries.subject: Drone swarming for defense
entries.author: Michelle Volz

entries.label: Software Eats Atoms via Tech-First Buyouts
entries.quote: I believe we’ll see more companies extend the scale of their software advantages by making acquisitions and implementing their software advantage post-acquisition.
entries.subject: Tech-led buyouts (software-enabled acquisitions)
entries.author: Oliver Hsu

entries.label: New Applications for Computer Vision and Video Intelligence
entries.quote: In 2024, we’ll likely see new applications of computer vision and video intelligence in the physical world.
entries.subject: Computer vision in the physical world
entries.author: Kimberly Tan

entries.label: A New Age of Maritime Exploration
entries.quote: A new age of maritime exploration is changing that, and founders are leading the way.
entries.subject: Maritime autonomy and ocean technology
entries.author: Grant Gregory

entries.label: Democratizing “Miracle Drugs”
entries.quote: We look forward to seeing builders innovating at the intersection of policy, biopharmaceutical manufacturing, financing, and clinical operations so we have viable means to bring these “miracle drugs” to market without bankrupting or breaking the system.
entries.subject: Access to high-cost therapies (GLP-1, cell and gene therapy)
entries.author: Julie Yoo

entries.label: Programming Medicine’s Final Frontier
entries.quote: Similarly, potentially curative programmable medicines like gene therapy can reuse components, like the delivery vehicles used to target specific cells, while swapping out the genetic cargo.
entries.subject: Programmable medicines (gene therapy platforms)
entries.author: Jorge Conde

entries.label: Enabling Our Healthcare Workforce to Do More
entries.quote: To this end, in 2024, I’m excited by software and data platforms that fundamentally empower providers.
entries.subject: Software for healthcare providers
entries.author: Vineeta Agarwala

entries.label: AI Will Supercharge the Future of Health
entries.quote: In 2024, I’m looking to see these leapfrog moments taking place across the science and healthcare industry, improving the lives of providers and patients by orders of magnitude.
entries.subject: AI in healthcare and life sciences
entries.author: Vijay Pande

entries.label: Voice-First Apps Will Become Integral to Our Lives
entries.quote: In 2024, I expect voice applications to become more useful and integrated into our lives.
entries.subject: Voice-first AI applications
entries.author: Anish Acharya

entries.label: Narrowly Tailored, Purpose-Built AI
entries.quote: In 2024, I predict we’ll see narrower AI solutions.
entries.subject: Vertical (purpose-built) AI applications
entries.author: Olivia Moore

entries.label: AI Tools Will Teach Kids
entries.quote: In 2024, we’re likely to see groundbreaking new AI tools, thoughtfully and meticulously designed for children.
entries.subject: AI tools for children's education
entries.author: Zach Cohen

entries.label: Code-Free AI Generators Spark New Behaviors
entries.quote: As state-of-the-art generative AI technologies drive the marginal cost of creation to near-zero, we’ll see entirely new consumer behaviors emerge.
entries.subject: Generative AI consumer creation tools
entries.author: Bryan Kim

entries.label: Creativity Gets Supercharged
entries.quote: There is immense potential for more interactive tools that act as a creative copilot and enable a true conversation with AI, far beyond the basic inpainting/outpainting functionality we see today.
entries.subject: AI creative tools
entries.author: Justine Moore

entries.label: Entering a New Era of Decentralization
entries.quote: However, thanks to the “living laboratory” of web3 over the past few years, more best practices for decentralization have been emerging.
entries.subject: Decentralized governance (DAOs)
entries.author: Miles Jennings

entries.label: Resetting the UX of the Future
entries.quote: But now, developers are actively testing and deploying new tools that could reset frontend UX (user experience) for crypto in the year ahead.
entries.subject: Crypto user experience (passkeys, smart accounts, embedded wallets)
entries.author: Eddy Lazzarin

entries.label: The Rise of the Modular Tech Stack
entries.quote: But the biggest advantage of an open-source, modular tech stack is that it unlocks permissionless innovation; allows participants to specialize; and incentivizes more competition.
entries.subject: Modular blockchain tech stack
entries.author: Ali Yahya

entries.label: AI + Blockchains Come Together
entries.quote: Decentralized, open-source crypto networks will democratize (vs. concentrate) AI innovation, ultimately making it safer for consumers.
entries.subject: AI and blockchain convergence
entries.author: Andrew Hall and Daren Matsuoka and Ali Yahya

entries.label: Play to Earn Becomes Play and Earn
entries.quote: The dynamics of how resulting gaming economies are managed will continue to shift as we see P2E evolve beyond its initial growing pains.
entries.subject: Play-and-earn crypto games
entries.author: Arianna Simpson

entries.label: When AI Becomes the Gamemaker, Crypto Offers Guarantees
entries.quote: When lore, terrain, narrative, and logic are all procedurally generated — in other words, when AI becomes the game maker — we’re going to want to know that the game maker was credibly neutral.
entries.subject: Crypto verification of AI-generated games
entries.author: Carra Wu

entries.label: Formal Verification Becomes Less, Well, Formal
entries.quote: With increased adoption of formal methods-inspired tooling among developers and security specialists, we can expect the next wave of smart contract protocols to be more robust and less prone to costly hacks.
entries.subject: Formal verification of smart contracts
entries.author: Daniel Reynaud

entries.label: NFTs Become Ubiquitous Brand Assets
entries.quote: Heading into 2024, many of the conditions are in place for NFTs to become ubiquitous as digital brand assets — as Steve Kaczynski and I explain in a forthcoming book — for a wide array of companies and communities.
entries.subject: NFTs as brand assets
entries.author: Scott Duke Kominers

entries.label: SNARKs Go Mainstream
entries.quote: Each of these strategies has had limits in terms of cost or network scalability, but now, SNARKs (Succinct Non-interactive ARguments of Knowledge) are becoming more usable.
entries.subject: SNARKs (succinct proofs) for verifiable computation
entries.author: Sam Ragsdale
entries.note: Text states proving overhead fell from about 10^9 toward 10^6 (current, not a forecast).

entries.label: The Rise of the Developer as Buyer in Financial Services
entries.quote: In 2024, the developer will become one of the most important influencers in the purchase of financial services infrastructure.
entries.subject: Developers as buyers of financial infrastructure
entries.author: Angela Strange

entries.label: Tech Helps Community and Regional Banks Compete
entries.quote: My hope is that we’ll see fintech companies step up and provide needed tools and technology to help this ecosystem of banks compete with larger institutions, manage balance sheet risks effectively, and better serve their clients.
entries.subject: Technology for community and regional banks
entries.author: David Haber

entries.label: Financial Professional Services Get Supercharged by Software
entries.quote: The professional services work of financial services — the accountant, the tax adviser, the wealth manager, the investment banker — will change.
entries.subject: Generative AI for financial professional services
entries.author: Seema Amble

entries.label: LLMs Capture New “Foundational Customer Units”
entries.quote: In 2024, startups leveraging LLMs will capture data that has been challenging for incumbent operating systems to collect, while automatically tagging and storing it.
entries.subject: LLM data capture in vertical software
entries.author: Joe Schmidt

entries.label: New Tools for Banking and Trading
entries.quote: In 2024, we’ll see ambitious founders tackle some of the messiest problems that financial institutions have to offer.
entries.subject: Software for banking and trading operations
entries.author: Marc Andrusko

entries.label: AI Will Push Latin American SMBs to Go Digital
entries.quote: As automated customer service becomes increasingly prevalent and consumers grow accustomed to these prompt interactions, businesses will be compelled to digitize their workflows.
entries.subject: AI assistants for Latin American SMBs
entries.author: Gabriel Vasquez

entries.label: AI Will Be the Key to Higher ROE
entries.quote: While the opportunity set spans both revenue generating and middle- to back-office functions, adoption in 2024 will be focused on use cases throughout engineering, procurement, legal, compliance, and risk management.
entries.subject: Generative AI adoption in financial institutions
entries.author: David Haber and Marc Andrusko

entries.label: Gaming: Where Alpha Geek Technologies Get Their Initial Product Market Fit
entries.quote: There are many new technologies on the cusp — AI, VR/AR, web3 — and embracing video games will be a key aspect of their success.
entries.subject: Games as first market for emerging technologies
entries.metric: cost to develop a game relative to traditional development
entries.author: Andrew Chen
entries.note: Number from the sentence 'eventually games will cost 1/1,000th what they traditionally did to develop'; no year given.

entries.label: AI-First Games That Never End
entries.quote: In 2024, we’ll see the first cohort of AI-first games from creators leveraging large models to enable novel game systems and mechanics.
entries.subject: AI-first games
entries.author: Jonathan Lai

entries.label: Games Become “Everything Simulators”
entries.quote: In 2024, expect to see games where the moment-to-moment involves coercion, deception, flirting, allying, leadership, peer pressure, influence, morality… you name it.
entries.subject: AI-driven social simulation games
entries.author: Jack Soslow

entries.label: From Chatbots to Avatars: AI Companions Go 3D
entries.quote: If 2023 was the year of AI companions we text with, next year those relationships will come to life through 3D avatars we talk to in real-time, verbally.
entries.subject: 3D AI companions
entries.author: Troy Kirwin

entries.label: The Next Disney is a Game Company
entries.quote: There’s been a lot of commentary recently on Disney getting back into video games, but I believe the next Disney will be a video game company.
entries.subject: Game companies as entertainment franchises
entries.author: Doug McCracken

entries.label: Anime Games Go Mainstream
entries.quote: In 2024, I expect anime’s momentum to continue.
entries.subject: Anime games
entries.author: Robin Guo

entries.label: A New Generation of UGC Game Developers Emerges
entries.quote: Combined, these two factors are likely to unleash millions of new creators next year.
entries.subject: User-generated content game development
entries.author: Joshua Lu

entries.label: The Minecraft Generation Ignites the Survival-Crafting Genre
entries.quote: The Valheim zeal just might catalyze the creation of a new, billion-dollar IP that resonates with the maturing preferences of the “Minecraft Generation.”
entries.subject: Survival-crafting games
entries.author: Jordan Mazer

entries.label: New Modes of Storytelling, Beyond Text-Based Chat
entries.quote: In the coming year, AI will advance beyond text-based chat to multimodal models.
entries.subject: Multimodal AI storytelling
entries.author: Sarah Wang

entries.label: CRM Will Be Powered by AI Data Collection
entries.quote: Though we’ve seen some sales tech companies experiment with generative AI around the edges, the next generation of sales tech will use generative AI to tackle this core data problem head-on.
entries.subject: AI-powered CRM
entries.author: Joe Morrissey

entries.label: The Consumer AI Battleground Moves from Model to UX
entries.quote: In 2024, consumer AI apps will break out by delivering the best user experience around unique use cases, less on model performance alone.
entries.subject: Consumer AI user experience
entries.author: Alex Immerman

entries.label: AI Interpretability
entries.quote: Interpretability, which is just a complex way of saying “reverse engineering” AI models, will be big in 2024.
entries.subject: AI interpretability
entries.author: Anjney Midha

entries.label: Creativity Reimagined
entries.quote: In 2024, these new AI playgrounds will make creative expression even more widely accessible.
entries.subject: AI creative tools
entries.author: Jennifer Li

entries.label: B2B AI Products Embedded in Your Workflow
entries.quote: In 2024, I’m optimistic we’ll see AI-native products become more embedded into workflows, performing tasks like proactively leaving comments, updating records, and completing action items after a simple approval from the user.
entries.subject: AI-native B2B workflow products
entries.author: Zeya Yang

entries.label: The New “Division of Labor”
entries.quote: As technology evolves, it will enhance our creative and problem-solving abilities.
entries.subject: Human-AI division of labor
entries.author: Yoko Li
entries.note: Short text; the idea is stated as a question about new means of creation.

entries.label: LLMs Advance Robotic Process Automation Systems
entries.quote: In 2024, I’ll be excited to see the market for LLM-powered robotic process automation (RPA) companies take off.
entries.subject: LLM-powered robotic process automation
entries.author: Kimberly Tan
